ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.60:0.40 high-intensity to low-intensity pixel distribution; white/light grey pixels dominate the distal regions while dark grey/black pixels are concentrated in the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous zones are mapped to the distal two-thirds of both the left and right lobes. Low-intensity (black) zones are mapped to the median notch area and the leading edge margin. Heavy dark-pixel mottling and linear streaks are overlaid across the high-intensity distal zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 15-20 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 12 percent of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; pixel amplitude varies between 3 and 10 pixels; approximately 14 distinct peaks visible on the right lobe and 12 on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex curvature originating from the median notch extending towards the distal tips, with a slight concavity appearing on the posterior margin of the outer lobe sections.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel dark-pixel linear tracks (rake marks) on the right distal lobe (oriented diagonally toward the tip) and the left distal lobe (oriented roughly 45 degrees from the midline).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring visible on both distal lobes; irregular indentation/notch on the superior-lateral margin of the left fluke tip.
